item.title: Regexp query
item.description:
Regexp query #

Returns documents that contain terms matching a regular expression.

A regular expression is a way to match patterns in data using placeholder characters, called operators. For a list of operators supported by the regexp query, see Regular expression syntax. Use the regexp query when neither prefix, suffix nor wildcard can express the shape — alternation, character classes, repetition.

Inside a nested query: not supported yet — the clause is rejected with an HTTP 400 naming the offending clause.
